title: Puente NEA — Landing
brief: Landing page for Puente NEA, a software factory from northeast Argentina (custom software, automation, AI adoption for SMBs). Inspired by shipperslab.tech sections (hero, services with interactive figures incl. a robot, team, FAQ, CTA, footer). Hero uses the bridge illustration; footer uses the petrol-blue digital workshop illustration.

artboards.title: Puente editorial
artboards.tradeoff: Closest to the reference: calm, editorial and very readable, with a robot, before/after and an automation flow inline per service; the least surprising of the three

artboards.title: Taller nocturno
artboards.tradeoff: Dark, product-like and demo-first: a live WhatsApp assistant drives a backstage dashboard and makes automation + AI tangible; the dark theme carries less of the bridge's warmth

artboards.title: Cruzar el puente
artboards.tradeoff: Most memorable: a horizontal scroll journey across the bridge guided by Nea, a capybara-robot mascot, plus a time-savings calculator; playful tone and scroll-jacking may not suit conservative buyers

artboards.title: Hablemos (formulario)
artboards.tradeoff: Contact page linked from the 01 CTA: 3-step form (who, contact by email or WhatsApp, problem) that shows the email the team receives; one field group per step lowers friction but adds two clicks versus a single form
